children: Switzerland has banned the purchase and import of gold originating in Sudan, and prohibited the sale to Sudan of certain goods used in gold mining and gold extraction, the government said on Wednesday.
"In so doing, the Federal Council is aligning itself with the EU’s equivalent sanctions. The measures will come into force on 10 September", the Swiss government said.
In July, the European Union announced new sanctions against Sudan by targeting the country's gold trade, which it said was being used to finance the military conflict in the country.
